findings.note: ESPN lists Malkin with 6 goals and 3 assists in 11 games this season, averaging about 17:01 of ice time. He has no power-play assists, no assists in 7 losses, and no points in his one game against Utah, so his recent assist rate is low.

Malkin missed the Oct. 24 overtime win over Nashville with an illness. He practiced on Sunday with Chinakhov, Brazeau and Girard, which suggests he will likely play Thursday, but his status should be confirmed at morning skate. The report also says Utah defenseman John Marino is out week to week.

In the Oct. 19 game against Utah, the projected lineup had Malkin at right wing on the second line with Koivunen and Novak, not centering his own line or playing with Crosby. In that game he had 0 points in 16:34, and Utah won 5-4.
